exposure: Insulin delivery method (continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion - CSII, or multiple daily injections - MDIs)
outcome: Partial remission of type 1 diabetes (defined by insulin dose-adjusted HbA1c)
cohort: Newly diagnosed Swedish children with type 1 diabetes, identified through the Swedish National Quality Register (SWEDIABKIDS) and the Better Diabetes Diagnosis study.
finding: Use of continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII), male sex, and shorter diabetes duration were associated with a higher frequency and/or longer duration of partial remission in Swedish children with type 1 diabetes.
followup_time: Up to 24 months after diabetes onset
